pages.quiz:
ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 50
   C. 11
   D. 100

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

3. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

4. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

5. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 13
   C. 41
   D. 3

6. Solve for x: x + 4 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 6

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 105
   B. 22
   C. 30
   D. 44

8. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 156
   D. 144

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

10. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36

12. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 2
   D. 25

13. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

14. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 17
   C. 7
   D. 15

15. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 2, 3, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 6

16. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

17. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

18. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

19. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 73

20. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

21. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

22. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

23. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 17
   C. 16
   D. 8

24. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 1
   C. 57
   D. 56

25. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 77
   C. 36
   D. 18

26. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 26

27. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 81

28. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

29. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 2

30. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
